job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Agent Workflow Engineering

Design multi-agent workflows using DAGs or state machines
Implement reasoning patterns such as Chain-of-Thought

Tool and API Integration

Build tools for REST APIs, SQL queries, and enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, ITSM, contact centers)
Enable safe and controlled tool execution

Prompt and Reasoning Design

Create system prompts, few-shot templates, and context injection strategies
Perform prompt testing and optimization

Memory Systems

Implement short-term and long-term memory (vector-based)
Optimize context usage

Evaluation Systems

Build evaluation pipelines including LLM-as-judge and deterministic tests
Define success metrics for agent performance



Technical Stack

Must Have

Strong Python skills
Experience with at least one: LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel
Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, or similar)
Solid understanding of prompt engineering, RAG, and API integration




Good to Have

LangGraph for stateful agents
Tools such as Promptflow, Langfuse, or RAGAS
Multi-agent frameworks (CrewAI, AutoGen
